detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #16 Hardware Persona A motherboard, BIOS, chassis, and product model should belong to the same machine. PH4NTXM generates these reported identities as a connected hardware profile. The selected ecosystem constrains product family, SKU, board, chassis, UUID, serials, and matching DMI-related text. Supported reporting files are exposed through read-only runtime mounts, and downstream CPU, GPU, display, and command views consume the generated state. Lone Wolf has its own hardware generator. The scope is selected reporting surfaces. The feature does not replace firmware or physically emulate different hardware. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
